desk.title: എഴുത്തുമേശ
desk.description: Your works in progress. Pick up where you left off, or start something new.
desk.todayHint: Words you have written today, across all your works.
desk.streakHint: You have written on {n} days in a row. Write a little every day to keep it going.
desk.wordsHint: Total words across all your works.
desk.localMode: Local mode: your work is saved in this browser only.
desk.firstWorkHint: Choose a സാഹിത്യരൂപം (writing type). You can change fonts, margins and page size later.
desk.importHint: # lines become titles, ## chapters; in a screenplay, “Name: line” becomes dialogue.

trashWork.title: Move “{title}” to the trash?
trashWork.body: You can restore it from the Trash tab any time.

books.title: പുസ്തകങ്ങൾ
books.description: Collect your works into a book with covers, contents and front pages, then export it as one PDF.
books.empty: No books yet. Use “New book” to collect chapters from your works.

delete.title: Delete the book “{title}”?
delete.body: Its covers and front pages go. The works used as chapters stay on your desk.

trash.title: ചവറ്റുകുട്ട
trash.description: Works you deleted. Restore them, or empty the trash to delete them permanently.

emptyConfirm.title: Empty the trash?
emptyConfirm.body: {works} will be deleted permanently. This can’t be undone.

deleteForever.title: Delete “{title}” forever?
deleteForever.body: It will be removed with its versions and Story World. This can’t be undone.

keyboard.manglishHint: Type in English letters, get Malayalam (Ctrl/⌘ + M to switch)
keyboard.malayalamHint: Type Malayalam with a built-in keyboard layout

layouts.inscriptHint: Standard Government of India layout, the one in Windows, macOS and Linux
layouts.systemHint: Use the Malayalam keyboard set up in your system or phone

keyboard.chilluTip: Type a consonant, ് and ] for a chillu: ന ് ] → ൻ
keyboard.passThrough: If your computer already types Malayalam, Litma leaves those keys alone.

mobile.keepSelection: Your selection is kept while you use the tools.

settings.languageHint: The language of menus and buttons. Your writing is not affected.

download.title: Litma for your computer
download.body: The same Litma, as an app for Mac and Windows. Your work syncs with the web.
download.soon: The first release is on its way
download.navTitle: Download Litma for Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android
download.heroLink: Get the app for Mac and Windows
download.heroBody: The same Malayalam writing desk as on the web, in its own window. Your works sync with your account everywhere.
download.inApp: You're already using the Litma app.
download.allBody: Pick another device or get Litma for someone else.
download.macReq: macOS 11 Big Sur or later. One app for Apple silicon and Intel.
download.iosReq: For iPhone and iPad. On its way to the App Store.
download.androidReq: For Android phones and tablets. On its way to Google Play.
download.mobileSoon: The mobile app is on its way. Until then, Litma works in your phone's browser.
download.linuxSoon: There's no Linux app yet, but Litma works fully in your browser.
download.webBody: Litma runs in any modern browser, on any computer or phone.

steps.mac1: Open Litma.dmg from your Downloads folder.
steps.mac2: Drag Litma into the Applications folder.
steps.mac3: The first time, right-click Litma in Applications and choose Open, then Open again.
steps.win1: Open Litma-win.exe from your Downloads folder.
steps.win2: If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click More info, then Run anyway.
steps.win3: Follow the installer. Litma opens when it's done and adds a desktop shortcut.

download.unsignedNote: Litma isn't signed with an Apple or Microsoft certificate yet, so your computer asks once before opening it. The app is the same as this website.
download.autoUpdate: Litma updates itself: when a new version is out, the app offers to install it.
download.deskBody: Faster to open, its own window, and it keeps working when the connection drops.

manglish.keysHint: Space accepts · ↑↓ or 1–7 to pick · Esc keeps English

saved.title: Saved words
saved.emptyBody: Look a word up in the dictionary and press Save. Your saved words appear here while you write.
saved.insert: Put this word in your text
saved.pickHint: Tap a word or a synonym to put it in your text.

update.webBody: Reload to get the newest version. Your writing is safe on this device.
update.desktopBody: You have {current}. The update downloads in the background and installs when you restart.
update.required: This version is required to keep syncing your work. Update now.
update.desktopAuto: Checks for updates every few hours and installs them when you say so.
update.webAuto: The website updates itself; you'll see a reload prompt when a new version is live.

nattarivu.title: നാട്ടറിവ്
nattarivu.pageIntro: Malayalam–Malayalam, English–Malayalam and Malayalam–English, with synonyms and opposites. Browse നാട്ടറിവ് for words about nature and everyday life, or save words to keep them at hand while you write.
nattarivu.intro: Malayalam words for flowers, trees, birds, seasons, farming and everyday life, with their English meanings. Tap a word to open it in the dictionary.
